transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... ever since I tried to turn my art into a real freelance business, I just keep getting really wound up over things like invoices and client messages. 

I get overwhelmed, and then I just avoid them. But I end up avoiding them until I'm literally crying at my kitchen table, or I start forgetting to do normal stuff, like paying my own bills. It's just gotten to be a lot to handle.
Have you had similar struggles with organization and putting off tasks throughout your life, or is this entirely new since starting your business?

No, it's really just since I started trying to do this freelance thing. I mean, I've never been the most organized person in the world, but I always managed fine. I paid my bills on time, I kept up with things... it wasn't a problem before. It's just all this new stuff with the business that's making me freeze up like this.
Aside from the business, do you find yourself worrying excessively about many other everyday areas of your life?

No, not really. Um, I don't think so, anyway. It's pretty much just the freelance stuff. I mean, I don't sit around worrying about... I don't know, my health or everyday things. It's really just whenever I have to deal with the business side of my art, that's when I get completely overwhelmed. Everything else in my life feels mostly fine.
